input.command: find etl -type f | xargs wc -l && cat etl_pipeline.py
cat etl/fields.py etl/steps.py etl/request.py etl/errors.py etl/ops/common.py etl/ops/__init__.py
grep -n "def normalize\|def check\|Field(\|class .*(\(Field\|Text\|Label\|List\|Map\|Record\|Expr\|Choice\|Op\))\|raw\[" -r etl/ops etl/expr.py | head -60; cat etl/ops/core.py
grep -n "normalize(\|\.read(\|raw\b" -r etl/ops etl/expr.py | grep -v "^etl/ops/core.py"; grep -n "List(\|Map(" -r etl/ops | head -40

PY=/Users/luke/conductor/workspaces/task/islamabad/.venv/bin/python3.14; L=$(printf 'a%.0s' {1..65}); E=$(printf 'a%.0s' {1..64});
for r in '{"pipeline":{"steps":[{"op":"select","columns":["id","customer_lifetime_value_including_all_historic_orders_and_refunds"]}]},"dataset":[]}' \
'{"pipeline":{"steps":[{"op":"'$L'"}]},"dataset":[]}' \
'{"pipeline":{"steps":[{"op":"filter","where":"x\ty"}]},"dataset":[]}' \
'{"pipeline":{"steps":[{"op":"rename","mapping":{"'$L'":"'$E'"}}]},"dataset":[]}' \
'{"pipeline":{"steps":[{"op":"rename","mapping":{"a":"'$L'"}}]},"dataset":[]}' \
'{"pipeline":{"steps":[{"op":"branch","branches":[{"when":"true","steps":[{"op":"cast","column":"a","to":"'$L'"}]}]}]},"dataset":[]}' \
'{"pipeline":{"steps":[{"op":"summarize","metrics":[{"as":"'$L'","fn":"sum","column":"a"}]}]},"dataset":[]}' \
'{"pipeline":{"steps":[{"op":"append","rows":[{"a":"'$L'"}]}]},"dataset":[]}' \
'{"pipeline":{"steps":[{"op":"select","columns":["'$E'"]}]},"dataset":[{"'$E'":1}]}'; do echo "$r" | $PY etl_pipeline.py --execute; done
